ci_tasks.description: Validate PAY-1 contract against CS-0 schema.
No PAN/CVV fields in resources or logs.
Adapter does not write core tables or emit EVT-1 directly.
Property tests for webhook replay and signature verification.
Ash.Tracer spans and OTel metrics/logs present.
ProviderEvent has correlation_hash with (provider, correlation_hash) identity.
Reconciliation verifies amount/currency after hash lookup.
Both real-time (1hr/$50) and monthly variance alerts fire correctly.
Identical params return cache; changed params suggest attempt_count increment.
CI fails if new sensitive field added without Inspect exclusion.
Unknown fields emit one aggregated alert per provider per hour.
SDKs derive keys from context and reuse on retries.

gates.failure_message: verify_payment_reference MUST expose evidence_digest_sha256 output field (proof digest pointer).

acceptance_criteria: No domain resource stores PAN, CVV, or raw card track data.
Only provider tokens/ids are stored; any sensitive fields are rejected at validation.
Logs and audit trails never include secrets or raw payment method data.
gates.description: No PAN/CVV storage and token-only PSP integration.
gates.failure_message: No PAN/CVV storage and token-only PSP integration.
negative_tests: Attempt to persist a field resembling PAN/CVV fails with ERR_FORBIDDEN or ERR_BAD_REQUEST.
Attempt to log webhook payload with secrets is blocked/redacted.
gates.title: Pay 1 P0 001

acceptance_criteria: initialize_payment/confirm_or_capture/refund accept an idempotency_key and return the same outcome for repeats.
Reusing the same idempotency_key with different request parameters returns ERR_CONFLICT with subcode LOCKS_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE_MISMATCH.
Webhook ingestion dedupes repeated provider_event_id deliveries without duplicating domain state changes.
gates.description: Idempotency is required and parameter-consistent for all payment commands.
gates.failure_message: Idempotency is required and parameter-consistent for all payment commands.
negative_tests: Replay the same webhook event twice; second attempt is a no-op and does not double-post ledger effects.
Reuse idempotency_key with different amount/currency results in an error.
property_tests: Fuzz: random duplicate deliveries and out-of-order events never lead to multiple captures for the same attempt.
gates.title: Pay 1 P0 002

acceptance_criteria: Unsigned or invalid-signature webhooks return ERR_FORBIDDEN with subcode EXT_SIGNATURE_INVALID.
Timestamp/out-of-window payloads are rejected with ERR_FORBIDDEN and subcode EXT_TIMESTAMP_SKEW.
Verified events are deduped and persisted durably before any 2xx response.
Provider exports can be joined deterministically to PaymentAttempt/ProviderEvent records.
gates.description: Webhook signature verification and replay protection are enforced.
gates.failure_message: Webhook signature verification and replay protection are enforced.
negative_tests: Send valid signature but stale timestamp: rejected.
gates.title: Pay 1 P0 003

acceptance_criteria: All payment mutations require tenant context; missing tenant returns ERR_FORBIDDEN (TEN_TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING mapping).
Tenant is derived only from trusted, signature-bound metadata or configured mappings (not untrusted query params).
gates.description: Tenant routing is deterministic and cross-tenant access is hidden.
gates.failure_message: Tenant routing is deterministic and cross-tenant access is hidden.
negative_tests: Attempt cross-tenant read using a valid ID returns ERR_NOT_FOUND.
Attempt to route tenant using untrusted param is rejected.
gates.title: Pay 1 P0 004

acceptance_criteria: Adapter module contains no repo inserts/updates into core domain resources; all writes occur through Ash actions in core.
Domain events are emitted only by core after commit (EVT-1), never by adapter.
gates.description: Adapter boundary: no direct core table writes and no direct EVT-1 emission.
gates.failure_message: Adapter boundary: no direct core table writes and no direct EVT-1 emission.
negative_tests: Static analysis/test fails if adapter depends on core repo modules for writes.
Adapter attempting to publish EVT-1 directly fails review gate.
gates.title: Pay 1 P0 005

acceptance_criteria: Artifacts MUST NOT contain ERR_* underscore primary codes; canonical forms are used (ERR_BAD_REQUEST, ERR_CONFLICT, ERR_FORBIDDEN, ERR_NOT_FOUND, ERR_UNAUTHENTICATED).
gates.description: ERR-1 primary error codes MUST be canonical (no underscores) on all public surfaces.
gates.failure_message: ERR-1 primary error codes MUST be canonical (no underscores) on all public surfaces.
negative_tests: If any API response emits error.code containing an underscore, request MUST fail CI (wire format violation).
gates.title: Pay 1 P0 006

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation imports are idempotent and can be re-run without duplicating settlement rows.
Provider exports can be joined deterministically to PaymentAttempt/ProviderEvent records.
gates.description: Reconciliation is authoritative and idempotent.
gates.failure_message: Reconciliation is authoritative and idempotent.
negative_tests: Re-run same reconciliation file; no duplicate rows are created.
gates.title: Pay 1 P1 001
